title: Perfect/lisse equivalence under contractible evaluation
statement: For J,O,U and the fixed canonical F,G [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model], assume the small sectionwise derived category and normalized contractible evaluation data [lem-zl-contractible-derived-sections-tensor]. Then F is fully faithful, triangulated, and strong symmetric monoidal, and it identifies perfect scalar complexes with lisse O-complexes. The inverse restriction is the actual G, with both inclusion comparison isomorphisms.

source.place: Lemma 4.1(1)-(2), the duality argument in the proof of (2)

proof.text: Obtain F left adjoint to G, invertible unit, braided F and monoidal G. Full faithfulness follows from the invertible unit.
The exact constant functor, universal derived extension and exact coefficient equivalence make their composite triangulated.

For dualizable X, transpose Hom(X,Y) to Hom(1,Y tensor X-dual). The monoidal functor transports the exact pairing, so the two transpositions intertwine its map on morphisms. Apply the adjunction at the unit, transported through F(1) isomorphic to 1, to prove G induces a bijection on these Hom sets.

Convert the recorded evaluation/coevaluation criterion for perfect ring complexes into IsDualizable. Both monoidal functors preserve duals. Restrict the adjunction to perfect and lisse full subcategories; both restricted functors are fully faithful and hence give an equivalence, with literal inclusion squares.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 4.1(1)-(2), the duality argument in the proof of (2)
